description: FORCED_TODO_PLAN_PROMPT is injected when the turn's model measures below the copse.forced-planning intellect threshold — it exists specifically to prop up weaker models. decideForcedPlanning is thoroughly unit-tested; the prompt it returns is not, so nothing checks that a weak model actually plans when it fires. That is the arm that matters, because a strong model plans anyway and would hide the failure.

tasks.description: Multi-file rename plus a new test — the shape of request the pack fires on. The prompt's first instruction is 'before any other tool call, call update_todos', so first-tool-is is the literal check.
